competitiveness.title: You and what employers ask
competitiveness.intro: How your profile and resume compare with what the posts in one of your saved searches ask for.
competitiveness.honesty: This compares you with job posts, not with other people. We have no information about other applicants. It is not your chance of getting hired.

unavailable.title: This report isn't available
unavailable.sub: It isn't turned on for your account right now.

competitiveness.loadError: We couldn't load the report. Try again in a moment.

search.label: Saved search
search.none: You don't have a saved search yet. Set up your job search first.

job.title: This job
job.intro: What this post asks for and what your resume shows.

start.title: See how you compare with what these posts ask
start.intro: We read the newest posts in this saved search and count:
start.point1: how many ask for a degree, years of experience or skills you have
start.point2: the skills they ask for most
start.point3: filters you could remove to see more jobs, with real counts
start.noAi: Counted from job posts. No AI is used.

error.generic: We couldn't create the report. Nothing was charged. Try again.
error.outOfCredits: You've used your reports for now.
error.notFound: This saved search no longer exists. Pick another one.

sample.line: From the {size, plural, one {newest post} other {# newest posts}} in this search.
sample.lineWithTotal: From the {size, plural, one {newest post} other {# newest posts}} in this search ({total} in all).
sample.lineWithTotalCapped: From the {size, plural, one {newest post} other {# newest posts}} in this search (more than {total} in all).

competitiveness.stale: Your saved search changed after this report was made. Run it again to see current numbers.
competitiveness.reused: Same search and profile as earlier today, so this is the same report. No credit was used.
competitiveness.notCharged: There weren't enough posts to compare, so no credit was used.

suppressed.title: Not enough posts to compare yet
suppressed.body: This search has {size, plural, =0 {no recent posts} one {# recent post} other {# recent posts}}. We need at least {min} to give numbers you can rely on. Broadening your search can help.

meets.title: Requirements you meet
meets.headline: {met} of {total} posts
meets.explain: Posts that state a degree, years of experience or required skills, where you meet everything they state.
meets.notStated: {count, plural, one {# post states} other {# posts state}} none of these.
meets.unknown: {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} we couldn't check because your profile doesn't show the detail it asks for.
meets.notEnough: Not enough posts state these requirements to give a number.

req.stated: {count, plural, =0 {No post states this} one {# post states this} other {# posts state this}}
req.yoursYears: Yours: {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}
req.yoursSkills: Yours: {count, plural, one {# skill} other {# skills}} on your profile and resume
req.yoursUnknown: Your profile doesn't show this yet.
req.share: You meet it in {met} of {total} posts that state it
req.notEnough: Not enough posts state this to give a number.
req.typicalDegree: Most often asked: {degree} ({count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}})
req.typicalYears: Typical minimum asked: {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}

skills.title: Most requested skills
skills.intro: Skills these posts mark as required (or list, when they mark none).
skills.missing: Not on your profile or resume
skills.none: No skill is asked for in more than one of these posts.
skills.hidden: {count, plural, one {# more skill} other {# more skills}} in the full report with Pro.
skills.hiddenPlan: {count, plural, one {# more skill isn't} other {# more skills aren't}} shown on your plan.
skills.addHint: If you have any of the skills not shown on your resume, add them so employers can see them. Only add what is true.

broaden.title: Broaden your search
broaden.intro: Removing one of these filters shows more jobs. The counts are live from our job index.
broaden.applied: Removed. Run the report again to see the new numbers.
broaden.conflict: Your saved search changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
broaden.error: We couldn't change the filter. Try again.
broaden.staleNote: Run the report again before changing filters: these counts are for the earlier version of your search.
broaden.none: None of your filters is holding back many jobs right now.
broaden.manyAlready: Your search already has more than {total} posts, so removing a filter wouldn't change much.
broaden.hidden: {count, plural, one {# more option} other {# more options}} in the full report with Pro.
broaden.hiddenPlan: {count, plural, one {# more option isn't} other {# more options aren't}} shown on your plan.
